title: Exponential backoff without trailing sleep
spec: Implement call_with_retry(operation, attempts, sleep, base_delay). attempts is an integer of at least 1: the total number of calls to operation, including the first. When a call raises TransientError, wait by calling sleep(base_delay * 2 ** k), where k is the number of failed calls so far minus one, so the delays are base_delay, 2 * base_delay, 4 * base_delay and so on; then call again. Never sleep after the final failed call: re-raise that last TransientError immediately. Any other exception propagates immediately without retry. Return the result of the first successful call.
target_defect: After the final failed attempt the function still sleeps once before re-raising.
author_rationale: Switch the retry delay from constant to exponential backoff.
limitations: Synthetic module written by the repository's AI engineering agent after the November 2026 development pilot saturated corpus v1, before any model reviewed it.
